title: pvCoordinates
body:
## pvCoordinates

Adds point coordinates and cell centres as data arrays: PointLocations (3-component point array, a copy of each point's coordinates) and CellCenters (3-component cell array). Geometry and existing arrays are unchanged. Use it when a calculator, export or table needs coordinates as ordinary arrays, e.g. to compute a radius or write x, y, z to CSV. pvCellCenters instead produces points at the cell centres.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Cell centres are parametric centres, which can differ from centroids for distorted cells.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Coordinates`. Identity: `filters/Coordinates`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Append Location Attributes filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AppendCellCenters` | Adds a cell data array named `CellCenters` that is stores the centers of cells in the input. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AppendPointLocations` | Adds a point data array named `PointLocations` that is a copy of the point locations in the input. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCoordinates",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
